title: Premium Deck Series: Fire and Lightning: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."
The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.
"I got it! I got it! I—"
Vulshok shamans could never keep them alive for more than a few seconds, yet those few seconds seemed to be enough.
They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.
"If the whole world burns, I'll never grow cold."
Vulshok sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds. Dead or alive, they come back down with smiles on their faces.
"We're going to need a bigger gate." —Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain
"Elemental fire shimmers with rose hues and, unlike terrestrial blazes, smolders long after it's extinguished." —Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*
Man versus nature is not a fair fight.
"Most wizards consider a thunderbolt to be a proper retort." —Ertai, wizard adept
"I'm not indecisive. I just don't like to limit my options." —Maxti, pyromancer
"Even the threat of power has power." —Jeska, warrior adept
Many ogres extracted blood oaths from the oni they summoned. Others simply extracted blood.
"Some say it's better to think before you act. While those people are considering all the options, that's usually when I kill them." —Dravus, lava mage
Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.
